releases.displayName: Chess Infinity | November 2025 - Major Update Out Now

items.text: Hello again, Chess Fans,

A new major update is now available for Chess Infinity on all platforms. This update addresses a large number of known issues with the game. Be sure to update before your next play session for the best possible experience.
We thank you once more for your patience with us as we worked to prepare this patch. We know it's taken much longer than anticipated.
Multiplayer Stability
Faster, more stable multiplayer for smoother online matches and fewer disconnects
Improved clock sync & lobby matching for more reliable multiplayer sessions
Cross-platform matchmaking clarified, ensuring you can only match with players who allow it, reducing confusion
Social invites now work reliably across platforms, making it easier to play with friends
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317155/66b4b9f8335e0e0a458b7ceb5723e5c69536e3e0.png"]
Performance Improvements
Speed boosts on inventory and profile
Steam Deck speed improvements for an improved experience
Gameplay
Resolved issues with piece selection and movement, providing smoother piece control and removed potential piece floating or sinking glitches
The resign button issue has been resolved, where the button would occasionally disappear
Lesson text and highlights refined with clearer instructions and more accurate tactical feedback
Dropped pieces and lesson visuals have been fixed so that lessons behave predictably and look correct
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317155/27ede88d2480117db4941c33995b0c959dd021a5.gif"]
Stats and Achievements
Player stats, achievements and activities fixed so that progress and rewards now update correctly
“Fresh Wood” achievement unlock fixed, so there's no more missed achievements!
Visual & Environmental Polish
The dynamic weather toggle works properly, so you can choose your preferred environment
Rain visuals have been refined for better performance and cleaner visuals, and we've fixed the roof, so no more leaks!
Chess piece textures corrected so there are no more wrong or missing textures
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317155/347e7bcc8dfbef410ba128a59bb73b06c5e94362.gif"]

releases.displayName: Chess Infinity | March 2025 Update Out Now

items.text: A new update is now available for Chess Infinity on all platforms.
The update addresses a number of known issues with the base game.
Be sure to update before you next play for the best possible experience.
Lighting improvements: across all in-game environments, particularly attention paid to darker environments.
Chess set readability: improvement readability across various environments and times of day.
Level loading screens now match the environment you choose.
Added an additional camera option to enable focus on pieces.
Adjustment to the game rating system to better reflect your actual performance in each game.
New intro cameras for the environments.
Fixes to the dynamic weather to stop it raining more than it should.
Fixed an issue with favourited chess sets so that it retains its place in the list.
Fixed an issue with a glitched butterfly stuck in mid air in the Japanese environment.
Fixes where sometimes the player could lose input focus.
Fixed an issue where VFX audio may still play even when VFX is turned off.
Fixed a rare bug that caused the game to occasionally lock on checkmate.
Fixed a rare bug that caused pieces to levitate in lessons.
Various audio improvements.
Ray tracing now enabled and set as default (PC only).
Introduced 'Performance' and 'Fidelity' modes for PS5 Pro - both modes offering ray tracing and optimising either frame rate or resolution.
Note: ray tracing is enabled by default on PS5 Pro ONLY.
The Ripstone Team

topNew: Note: ray tracing is enabled by default on PS5 Pro ONLY.

releases.displayName: Chess Infinity | Social Media Update - W/B 17/03/25

items.text: Greetings Chess Fans!
Another week, another batch of the latest social media updates from the world of Chess Infinity!
If you haven’t already, follow our socials and join the Discord to stay up to date with the latest news, updates, and community highlights!

The comprehensive multiplatform update we mentioned previously is coming next week! Your feedback has been invaluable in helping shape and prioritise this. Expect bug fixes, performance optimisations, and quality of life improvements alongside an upcoming DLC. More details to be revealed soon.

notes.title: ⚡ Harness the Wrath of Zeus in Ancient Greece!

items.text: What happens when chess meets Greek mythology? Thunderous captures, sunlit ruins, and an atmosphere charged with power.
This week, we showcased Chess Infinity’s Greek battlegrounds, where your strategy can be backed by the might of Zeus himself.

notes.title: 🔊 Turn Up the Volume – Chess Has Never Sounded This Good!

items.text: Chess Infinity isn’t just about the visuals. It’s about feeling every move. Our dynamic audio system swells and shifts with key moments, bringing every match to life.
The intensity rises as you go for checkmate, and quiet contemplation fills the pauses between turns.
Best experienced with headphones on!

We get it. Sometimes, tradition is best. For the chess purists out there, Chess Infinity also lets you position the camera for a top-down, classic chessboard view. Pure strategy, just the way you like it.
You can even turn off VFX and the UI, too - so it’s just you and the board.

Viking longhouses, stormy battles, and fiery captures. This week, we showcased another of Chess Infinity’s environments. Whether you’re playing under the Northern Lights or beneath stormy skies, our Norse battlegrounds bring raw, dramatic energy to every game.

Has anyone defeated Aion? Our toughest AI opponent isn’t holding back. With an Elo rating of 2400, Aion is currently Chess Infinity’s ultimate challenge. We're still looking for someone who has defeated them. Have you? Let us know below!
🚀 Play now: loom.ly/H9B2gXo

This is chess, but with an immersive audio experience like never before. Get your best headphones on!
